The complete first-ready bundle was frozen with mode 0444 and the coordinator was signaled before this review began. A separate read verified every manifest digest and all seven frozen artifact modes before reviewing the unchanged chapter against the frozen inputs. No source revision was made.

## Findings

- Complete public method topology and order match the supplied ProviderConfigMap declaration. The class has one runtime-private readonly Map binding and no public instance data fields, extra methods, imports, dependency bodies, casts, suppression directives, or any annotations.
- Constructor uses native in, a distinct duplicate-key read followed by a distinct insertion-key read, shallow object spread, native Object.freeze on the rule and then on the instance. It consumes the iterable once. The duplicate branch creates the specified Error text. The native getter key may differ from the cloned rule providerId, and the code does not reconcile them.
- All static empty and immutable update constructions explicitly target the base ProviderConfigMap. Update assembly leaves the owned input Maps untouched and passes complete rule values into the constructor, so successful updates re-clone and re-freeze every shell while retaining the intended config references.
- Overlay reads both private Maps, preserves current positions and appends new keys, retains noncolliding shell metadata, and intentionally emits only providerId/templateId/providerName/enabled/config for collisions. Protected metadata overlay calls run with this as receiver and in the required order before config overlay; their undefined/null policy is delegated to the retained implementation.
- mapConfigs obtains public rules before mapping, spreads each shell before calling the transform directly, and passes the same rule and config references. reorder reads private keys, ignores missing requested keys, keeps the first requested occurrence, and then appends omitted original entries.
- set spreads the privately indexed existing shell and dispatches publicly to setRule. setRule replaces the shell wholesale while preserving the Map position. delete dispatches through public rules and compares the stored rule field with strict inequality.
- Mechanical projections return the specified references and detached mutable arrays. entries dispatches through public rules and creates mutable tuples typed as readonly. Neither a Map nor private state is returned.
- Validation dispatches through public entries, allocates a fresh path for each config, and flatMaps returned issue references without text or identity changes.
- Encoding dispatches through public rules, removes config through native object rest, copies remaining metadata before config.toJSON, and passes the resulting object to the retained objectWithoutUndefined helper. The chapter does not duplicate that helper or any schema/access/key/codec policy.
- No catches, normalization, validation additions, mutations of input config/rule objects, public own-key fields, or extra output freezing were found. Native and delegated failures are not translated.

No static discrepancy requiring a revision was identified. The preferred artifact is the entire first-ready chapter, unchanged.

## Limits

This is static review only. No authored runtime code, compiler, linter, tests, repository source, dependency implementation, settings, UI, environment inspection, or network was used. Lexical dependency availability and integration type compatibility were not executable-checked by this author. Synthetic-only coordinator verification and installation of the whole preferred chapter remain coordinator work. Shared access limits are self-enforced rather than technically isolated.
